    AI Overview
    Atlético Madrid secured a crucial 2-0 away victory against 10-man FC Barcelona in the 2025-26 UEFA Champions League quarter-final first leg on April 8, 2026, at Camp Nou. Goals from Julián Alvarez and Alexander Sørloth, following a first-half red card for Barça's Pau Cubarsí, gave Atlético a significant advantage ahead of the second leg. 
    Key Match Timeline - April 8, 2026 (Champions League QF Leg 1) 
    • 32’: Yellow card for Koke (Atlético).
    • 41’: Red card for Pau Cubarsí (Barcelona) after VAR check for bringing down Giuliano Simeone.
    • 45’: Goal! Julián Alvarez scores via free-kick to make it 1-0.
    • 46’: Substitutions for Barça; Gavi and Fermin replace Pedri and Lewandowski.
    • Second Half: Alexander Sørloth scores to double Atlético's lead.
    • Final Score: FC Barcelona 0-2 Atlético Madrid. 
    Recent & Upcoming Matchup Context 
    • April 14, 2026: Second leg of the Champions League quarter-finals at the Metropolitano.
    • April 4, 2026: Barcelona defeated Atlético 2-1 in La Liga just before the European tie.
    • Feb/Mar 2026: Atlético won the Copa del Rey semi-final tie against Barcelona. 
    Note: The results provided are based on information through April 8, 2026.
